newsitem.title: CHINA: China 1997 defence budget up 14.7 percent.
newsitem.headline: China 1997 defence budget up 14.7 percent.

text.p: China's defence budget in 1997 will be 80.57 billion yuan ($9.7 billion), an increase of 14.7 percent compared with the 1996 budget, Chinese sources said on Friday, quoting Finance Minister Liu Zhongli.
The 1997 budgeted figure marked an increase of 12.7 percent compared with actual spending in 1996, he was quoted as saying.
China increased its defence budget by 11.3 percent in 1996, compared with an increase of 14.59 percent in 1995 and 22 percent in 1994.

Actual defence spending in 1996 was 71.503 billion yuan ($8.6 billion), which exceeded the budget by 2.4 percent, Liu will tell parliament in his budget speech on Sunday. A part of the speech was seen in advance by Reuters.
